summary: The audit checks at least 20 units of graduate courses in Communication (COMM). Three of them must be theory or research methods courses that a department advisor picks with you, and a representative of the department examines you; you check both by hand. All of the coursework must be taken at Stanford.

PgoY5IuH-text.why: "Candidates for the PhD degree in other departments who elect a minor in Communication must complete a minimum of 20 units of graduate courses in the Department of Communication, including three theory or research methods courses. A representative of the department examines them. In consultation with the individual student, a department advisor determines the particular communication theory and methods courses." The 20 units are graduate-career COMM listings; the three theory or methods courses are among them and chosen with the advisor, so the student moves them in; the examination is by hand.
